name: Kusanagi Naoya
source:
Naoya is the main protagonist of the story. He moved into the Natsume household after his father died. He cooks for the Natsume family since neither [url=/c7921]Ai[/url], [url=/c35358]Kei[/url], nor [url=/c1434]Shizuku[/url] can cook decent meals.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakura_no_Uta]Wikipedia[/url]]


[spoiler]After graduating from Yumihari Gakuen, he went on to a national art university and worked as a part-time lecturer at Yumihari Gakuen. In this work, he becomes a full-time employee and becomes an art teacher. Together with the students, he revives the prestigious Yumihari Gakuen Art Club[/spoiler]
